payload.goal: Find MOFs that bind CO2 more strongly than water, from humid air, using 40 DFT lookups.

payload.text: Goal: CO2 that wins against water, so I need E_CO2 below -0.5 eV and below E_H2O. The pool has 500 frameworks and I can afford 40 lookups, 10 per round. I have no labels yet, so the only signal is the cheap oracle and the pore descriptors. Plan for round 1: look at the MACE ranking, look at narrow-pore frameworks with open metal sites (those polarize CO2), and keep the cost tier low because the goal says cheap metals. I will run both queries in parallel and render the top candidate to check the binding site is in a pore and not on the outer surface.

payload.text: Round 1 has no feedback, so this batch is a probe. Seven picks come from the MACE ranking (lowest S_mace among cheap metals), three from the narrow-pore open-metal-site list. P(hit) is low across the board: the base rate is about 2.8%, and I have no evidence yet that MACE ranks this pool well. I will keep every probability under 0.3.

payload.text: Calibration on the 10 labels I bought: Spearman between MACE S and DFT S is -0.21 and hit AUC is 0.33, on n = 10 that is too weak to trust. The round-1 picks were the best MACE scores and they did not bind better than average. The parity plot is a cloud, not a line. I should stop trusting the MACE order. Shift: use pore descriptors and open metal sites as the main signal, and fit a surrogate on the labels once I have enough of them.

payload.text: Batch from the surrogate's lowest mean − std and the narrow-pore OMS list. I raise P(hit) for frameworks that look like the round's hits (open metal site, PLD under 5 Å) and lower it for wide pores. I give no weight to S_mace, since calibration shows it does not rank this pool.

payload.text: Write the report. Cite the call for every number. Keep it short; list hits in order of DFT score.

Campaign mock-A5-P3-s0-202610291858 spent 40 of 40 DFT lookups and found 5 hits [c0033]. The first hit came at lookup 7 [c0008]. Round 1 followed the MACE ranking [c0002]. Calibration after round 1 gave Spearman -0.21 between MACE S and DFT S [c0009], so I stopped ranking by S_mace and moved to pore size and open metal sites plus the surrogate [c0012]. The strongest hit is m6f04406: E_CO2 -1.51 eV against E_H2O -1.40 eV [c0025]. Hits cluster at PLD under 5 Å with open metal sites [c0003]. Every hit was bought at a stated P(hit); the calibration of those probabilities is scored blind. MACE ranked 4 of the hits in its top 25 [c0002].
